objective: launch the new serum line in Oslo
audience: Oslo skincare buyers who value a premium look
insight: shoppers trust a real studio shot over an obvious render
proposition: a premium studio look that earns 90 orders

maker_recommendation.rationale: the human studio shoot needs 36 more orders to pay off, about 40% of the goal, so AI carries the volume

mandatories.text: If realistic AI people appear, label them under Article 50 for EU reach.

hypothesis: a studio hero shot lifts orders versus a plain AI mockup

assumptions.ref: break-even as a share of the goal (illustrative)

open_questions: is 90 orders reachable on 40 000 kr at the assumed conversion rate?
